# basistheory_reactor (Resource)

Reactor https://docs.basistheory.com/docs/api/reactors

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "basistheory_reactor" "my_reactor" {
  name = "My Reactor"
  code = <<-EOT
  module.exports = async function (req) {
    // Do something with `req.configuration.SERVICE_API_KEY`

    return {
      raw: {
        foo: "bar"
      }
    };
  };
  EOT
  configuration = {
    SERVICE_API_KEY = "key_abcd1234"
  }
}

# Reactor on the node24 runtime, with an execution role and runtime logs
resource "basistheory_reactor" "my_node24_reactor" {
  name = "My Node24 Reactor"
  code = <<-EOT
  module.exports = async function (context) {
    return {
      res: {
        body: {},
        headers: {},
        statusCode: 200
      }
    };
  };
  EOT

  runtime {
    image     = "node24"
    timeout   = 10
    resources = "standard"

    # The access the code runs with: `permissions` or `rule` blocks
    execution_role {
      rule {
        description = "Reveal general tokens"
        priority    = 1
        container   = "/general/"
        transform   = "reveal"
        permissions = ["token:read"]
      }
    }

    # Without this block logs are off, and logs turned on outside Terraform
    # are turned off on the next apply
    logs {
      enabled = true
      level   = "info"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The code that is executed when the Reactor runs
- `name` (String) Name of the Reactor

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) The Application's permissions used in the BasisTheory instance passed into the Reactor
- `configuration` (Map of String) Configuration for the Reactor
- `runtime` (Block List, Max: 1) Runtime configuration for the Reactor. When the whole block is omitted, the Reactor keeps the runtime it has, including an execution role and logs set outside Terraform (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--runtime))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp at which the Reactor was created
- `created_by` (String) Identifier for who created the Reactor
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Reactor
- `modified_at` (String) Timestamp at which the Reactor was last updated
- `modified_by` (String) Identifier for who last modified the Reactor
- `state` (String) Current state of the Reactor
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant identifier where this Reactor was created

<a id="nestedblock--runtime"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime`

Optional:

- `async` (Boolean) Whether the Reactor is configured for asynchronous execution
- `dependencies` (Map of String) Runtime dependencies
- `execution_role` (Block List, Max: 1) Execution role: the access the code runs with, set through `permissions` or `rule` blocks. Declare it here before, or together with, setting it through the API, Portal or CLI: when the `runtime` block is set and this block is omitted, an execution role set elsewhere is removed on the next apply that updates the resource. Provider versions that do not have this block remove it the same way, so upgrade before setting one (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--runtime--execution_role))
- `image` (String) Runtime image (e.g., node22)
- `logs` (Block List, Max: 1) Runtime logs. When the `runtime` block is set and this block is omitted, logs are off at level `info`: logs turned on outside Terraform, or a level other than `info` set there, are reset on the next apply that updates the resource. To keep them, add this block before applying (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--runtime--logs))
- `permissions` (List of String, Deprecated) List of permissions for the reactor. Use `permissions` inside an `execution_role` block instead; this attribute keeps working
- `resolutions` (Map of String) Runtime dependency resolutions
- `resources` (String) Resource allocation (e.g., standard)
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout setting in seconds
- `warm_concurrency` (Number) Warm concurrency setting

<a id="nestedblock--runtime--execution_role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime.execution_role`

Optional:

- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions granted to the execution role
- `rule` (Block Set, Max: 20) Access rules granted to the execution role (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--runtime--execution_role--rule))

<a id="nestedblock--runtime--execution_role--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime.execution_role.rule`

Required:

- `container` (String) The container of Tokens this rule is scoped to
- `description` (String) A description of this Access Rule
- `permissions` (Set of String) List of permissions to grant on this Access Rule
- `priority` (Number) The priority of this Access Rule, beginning with 1 and higher values having lower precedence
- `transform` (String) The transform to apply to accessed Tokens



<a id="nestedblock--runtime--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime.logs`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether runtime logs are captured. Defaults to false, so a block that only sets `level` captures nothing
- `level` (String) Level captured, together with every more severe level: `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`. Defaults to `info`
